scope: Independent read-only hash, configuration, identity, initialization, support-coverage and frozen-scorer recomputation audit; no simulator, rendering, source writes or process operations.
limitations: Hash equality validates inspected file bytes at freeze and audit, not an adversarial proof of loaded process memory.
Rigid-body coverage uses the independently USD-audited 13-body asset, with unchanged asset hash.
Successful simulation remains conditional on estimated geometry/materials and tactile proxy; this audit does not establish hardware success.
Aggregate outcome interpretation and intervals are provided by the separate evidence analysis.

audit_execution.operation: CPU-only read-only audit executed from standard input; no frozen source writes
